scope: Standing PGGMB Building in Bandar Seri Begawan, the 17-level mixed-use headquarters on Jalan Kianggeh that replaced the 1965 teachers’ building on the same site.

stories.title: The Tallest Building in Brunei Town Was Built by Teachers

review.notes: Published Qualla was checked first. Its exterior photograph is attribution-required and its apparent public-domain images do not show the tower. No photos adopted; the written building identification and original map control geometry.
